[[Watchtower Coast]] | armorer = y | merchant = y | henchman = y | skill trainer = y | storage = y | weaponsmith = y }} '''Beetletun''' is a small outpost between the [[Divinity Coast]], [[Bergen Hot Springs]] and [[Lion's Arch]]. {{Quotation|game| Historians speculate that in time out of mind, these now-ruined watchtowers guarded [[Kryta]] from some unknown northern threat. Now the crumbled towers stand like ancient stone soldiers still awaiting the arrival of that mysterious enemy from across the great saltwater lake called [[Giant's Basin]]. }} ==Getting there== *From [[Lion's Arch]], go northwest through the [[North Kryta Province]], then west through [[Nebo Terrace]]. *From [[Bergen Hot Springs]], go north then west through Nebo Terrace. *From the [[Divinity Coast (outpost)|Divinity Coast]], go east through the [[Watchtower Coast]]. ==Quests available== *[[Elder Hezron]] **[[The Undead Hordes]] ==NPCs== ===Allies=== ====Services==== *{{x}} 5 [[Chios]] ([[merchant]]) *{{x}}10 [[Dagan Sharru]] ([[collector]]) *{{x}} 10 [[Hamlin]] ([[weaponsmith]]) *{{x}} 15 [[Ephaz]] ([[skill trainer]]) *{{x}} 10 [[Sagren]] (collector) *{{x}} 15 [[Shada]] ([[armorer]]) *{{x}} 15 [[Xunlai Agent]] ([[storage upgrades]]) *{{x}} 24 [[Xunlai Chest]] ([[storage]]) ====Henchmen==== *{{w}} 12 [[Little Thom]] (Brawler) *{{w}} 12 [[Stefan]] (Fighter) *{{r}} 12 [[Reyna]] (Archer) *{{mo}} 12 [[Alesia]] (Healer) *{{n}} 12 [[Claude]] (Cultist) *{{me}} 12 [[Dunham]] (Enchanter) *{{e}} 12 [[Orion]] (Mage) ====Other allies==== *{{w}} 10 [[Elder Hezron]] ==Notes== *Complete exploration of this outpost contributes approximately 0.1% to the Tyrian [[Cartographer]] title. ==Trivia== *Beetletun is the only outpost whose name is not translated in the German or French versions of Guild Wars. *It could be speculated that the northern threat came from the island of [[Janthir]] north of the Giant's Basin delta {{gw2w|Shire of Beetletun}} {{Towns and outposts in Kryta}}
